reason: A Windows desktop companion plugin that opens configured media or livestream sites during background AI work, preserves per-site browser sessions, and controls playback by showing, hiding, suspending, or resuming Chromium process trees.

summaries.zh: 一个仅支持 Windows 的编程陪伴插件，可在 AI 后台工作时播放配置的网站视频或直播，并按对话状态控制窗口显示与暂停。
summaries.en: A Windows-only coding companion plugin that plays configured video or livestream sites during background AI work and controls the window and playback state according to conversation activity.

capabilities: Launches and controls Chromium app windows on Windows
Loads user-configured video or live-stream URLs
Persists site-specific cookies and login data in separate user-data directories
Injects a browser extension with a callback to the host plugin
Suspends and resumes entire Chromium process trees using Windows APIs and PowerShell
Terminates the managed process tree when the host exits
